name: Amy Cooks It
title: Amy Cooks It — weekly supper in 78756, events and catering in Austin
description: Five cooked dinners from $54 in Brentwood, Crestview, and Allandale. Events and catering for a room of 12 to 40. Send the date and headcount. Amy replies with a number before she cooks.

hero.lede: Five cooked dinners from $54, in Brentwood, Crestview, or Allandale. A room of 12 to 40, dropped off or hosted. Jerk chicken, mojo pernil, turkey chili. Send the date and the headcount. Amy replies with a number before she cooks.
hero.image_alt: Jerk chicken with rice and peas and steamed cabbage, a serving illustration standing in until a kitchen photograph replaces it

services.name: Weekly supper
services.promise: Dinner handled, without turning the house into a meal-prep account.
services.detail: Five nights, or three. Brentwood, Crestview, and Allandale.

services.name: Custom meal prep
services.promise: A week written for the people who actually live there.
services.detail: The portions, the rules, and a menu written for that house.

services.name: Events
services.promise: The night is the product. The food has to survive a room.
services.detail: Drop-off, or Amy stays. Twelve to forty guests.

services.name: Full-service catering
services.promise: Drop it off, or let Amy run the table.
services.detail: Chafing dishes, house sauces, half to reserve.
